However, hurst_tag is mean-revert (no durable trend), durability_bar is only 0.54, and the gate did not historically reduce drawdown in this market, so this is a fragile, short-horizon relative-strength call, not a trend forecast.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite a rank 3 score (1.065) and the best breadth in the set (0.643), this theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.6, crowded=true). The guardrails forbid treating crowding as a sell or fade, but it is a legitimate sizing-down caution, and underweight expresses relative caution without fading the leader. Hurst_tag mixed means the trend is unreliable, and with a 0.361 directional accuracy track record, a conditional underweight is the honest read.

theses.dissent: High breadth and a top-3 score could mean broad participation that sustains despite crowding; the crowding flag is coincident and has no forward edge, so underweight may merely underperform if the crowding dissipates without a price drawdown.
